zones.name: Water climate
zones.evidence: climate enum, band at the bottom of the scale

zones.name: Desert climate
zones.evidence: climate enum; default for sea-level heights no band claims

zones.name: Temperate climate
zones.evidence: climate enum; default fallback for gap heights

zones.name: Arctic climate
zones.evidence: climate enum; open top band; fallback above the top band

looks.label: Day-night curve
looks.technique: 48-slot table of darkness levels over the in-game day, plus a user offset; forced dark underground

looks.label: Walker animation by step count
looks.technique: animated frame list when steps_per_frame is above zero, otherwise one static image per direction

looks.label: Separation offset on spawn
looks.technique: each new walker moves along by an amount tied to the object count on its tile

looks.label: Large-type twin skin
looks.technique: each UI skin ships a large set with the same element names

looks.label: Per-language font key
looks.technique: the language table names the font file, so a language can change font without code

originals.name: Ambient walker crowd
originals.idea: a passenger-like event spawns a small crowd of walkers near the event, with a budget, a per-tile cap, a lifetime and a despawn when the road is gone
originals.keep: budget per event, four per tile per call, object cap per tile, random lifetime, despawn on empty
originals.change: spawn events from our town and loot events; budget and lifetime as zone data in seconds; add the grace timer the donor does not have

originals.name: Biome by height band with explicit precedence
originals.idea: zone biome is set by height bands in data, with a stated fallback
originals.change: state one precedence rule in the data; our fallback is temperate

originals.name: Shore placement rule
originals.idea: a coastal feature is valid only next to water
originals.change: our own coastal rule for our zone features

originals.name: Night clock table
originals.idea: darkness is a 48-slot table over the day, plus a user offset, forced dark underground
originals.keep: the table, the offset and forced dark underground
originals.change: a per-zone curve and an ember glow for our night

originals.name: Playlist shuffle without repeat
originals.idea: a random track that never repeats the one just played, with a sequential fallback
originals.change: biome-keyed ambience beds with a crossfade at borders, not a melody

originals.name: Large-type twin skin
originals.idea: every UI skin has a large twin with the same element names
originals.keep: same names in the large set, one layout
originals.change: our own palette and a touch-size rule instead of a fixed scale

originals.name: Animated or static by step count
originals.idea: a walker is animated only when its descriptor sets a step count
originals.change: our own idle loops for NPCs

originals.name: Per-category sound toggles
originals.idea: the player turns each sound category on or off
originals.change: our categories: footsteps, hit impacts, ambience, stingers
